title: Blood Pulse Resonance Alert
next_chapter_hook: "From the blood pulse resonance came Chen Nian's faint voice: Don't come, brother, it's a trap—Yet the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's sleeve was already burning on its own, Heavenly Fate Value draining frantically, and new visions were taking shape..."

text.content: "The Tianji Record Fragment trembled violently in his sleeve, as if it would break through the cloth at any moment. Chen Ji's expression shifted abruptly—that familiar yet alien aura—the Heavenly Eye—was gazing through the endless Void directly at him. The Holy Sect emissary's words still echoed in his ears, the Tianqing Sect's destruction was imminent, and now, at this moment, the chessboard of fate had simultaneously revealed another card."

"Just as Chen Ji prepared to use the Tianji Record to peer into the intent behind that gaze, a scorching force exploded from his chest. It was blood pulse resonance—that unsevered bond between him and Chen Nian, which had activated on its own under the Heavenly Eye's pressure. Pain, searing pain, as if ten thousand needles were piercing his heart simultaneously."

"Visions flooded into his mind like a tide. Darkness, profound darkness, tinged with the scent of blood. Chen Nian was suspended in midair by chains,诡异的符文阵 surrounded her on all sides. Her garments were torn, her body covered in ghastly wounds, and a robed figure was slowly raising a bone blade in its hand—This was the Holy Sect's most cruel 'Heavenly Fate Extraction Ritual.'"

dialogue.content: "(Voice transmitted through blood pulse resonance, fragmented and desperate) Brother... don't come... they're waiting for you... it's a trap..."

text.content: "Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Rage, like magma churning in his chest. He could scheme against the world, could lay plans spanning ten thousand years, but he had never prepared for any chess game involving Chen Nian. Because she was his only weakness, his only逆鳞 in this world. The Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve hummed due to its master's emotional turmoil."

"The Holy Sect emissary sensed something amiss, frowning slightly: "Chen Ji? You don't look well—" Before he finished speaking, a terrifying aura erupted from Chen Ji. That was not the pressure a Nascent Soul cultivator should possess—that was momentum surpassing Nascent Soul, pressing directly against the Tribulation Transcendence stage. The surrounding air seemed emptied, the Holy Sect emissary stumbled back several steps, his face filled with horror."

""I've memorized it." Chen Ji's voice was low as an abyss, every word carrying bone-deep coldness. "Holy Sect, Heavenly Fate Lock Key, Heavenly Fate Extraction Ritual." He slowly raised his head, the fire in his eyes replaced by something even deeper—cold killing intent at its most extreme. "You'd better pray she loses not a single drop more blood.""

"On the Tianqing Sect Competition Square, numerous disciples were forced to their knees by this pressure. They had never imagined that the useless senior brother who swept floors in the Servants' Quarters daily harbored such terrifying strength. Su Qingyao watched from afar, complex light flickering in her gaze—she had finally confirmed her suspicions, but this Chen Ji made her feel unfamiliar and afraid."

choice.prompt: "Blood pulse resonance continued, more visions of Chen Nian's situation flooding into Chen Ji's mind. Chen Ji had to make a choice—"

choices.description: "Use strength surpassing Nascent Soul stage to go directly to Holy Sect Forbidden Grounds to rescue her, even knowing it's a trap"
choices.visible_cost: "Expose all strength, step into enemy's home ground"
choices.risk_hint: "Since they set an ambush, there must be a follow-up plan"

text.content: "Chen Ji's form flashed, turning into streaming light hurtling toward the Holy Sect. However, just then, aweak voice came from the Tianji Record Fragment—Mo Xiansheng: "不可... the Heavenly Eye is waiting for you to step into that forbidden land... This is not an ordinary trap, it's a chess game tailor-made for you...""

choices.description: "Forcefully activate Tianji Record, consume 5 points of Heavenly Fate Value to foresee complete visions within the next three hours"
choices.risk_hint: "Heavenly Fate Value insufficient, less than 20 points remaining"

text.content: "Chen Ji endured the blood pulse resonance's intense pain, bit through his tongue and sprayed essence blood onto the fragment. The Tianji Record suddenly blazed with dazzling golden light, yet just as the vision began to take shape, an invisible force forcibly interrupted it—Chen Nian's figure was shrouded in thick mist, that was the special attribute of the "Heavenly Fate Lock Key" interfering with Heavenly Secrets."

choices.description: "Conceal aura through demonic path mist, travel together with Ye Qing"
choices.visible_cost: "Owe demonic path a favor, expose cooperation"

text.content: "Chen Ji condensed a thread of demonic path mist on his fingertip—that was the contact signal agreed upon with Ye Qing. After a moment, a cold voice sounded in his ear: "Chen Ji? You've finally come to me willingly. Tell me, what do you need my 'demonic path mist' for this time?" The tone carried a playful quality, yet showed no refusal."

"Just as Chen Ji weighed his options, Chen Nian's voice came through the blood pulse resonance once more, this time even fainter: "Brother... they're going to use my blood... to open something... the Heavenly Eye wants... wants to use you as its tool..." The voice cut off abruptly, replaced by a blood-curdling scream—the ritual had begun."

"Chen Ji's sanity nearly shattered at this moment. Sixteen years ago, he was powerless when Chen Nian was kidnapped; sixteen years later, he had calculated everything under heaven, yet never anticipated his sister being used as a key to open the forbidden gate. The Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve trembled violently from his master's emotional loss of control, its runes beginning to distort and deform."

dialogue.content: "(Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul's weak voice) Calm down... Chen Ji... the Heavenly Eye is attempting to lock onto your position through Chen Nian's blood pulse resonance... If you lose control... that's exactly what it wants..."

text.content: "Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcefully suppressing his churning emotions. His gaze gradually returned to clarity, but that clarity was more terrifying than rage—it was the coldness of bringing everything within calculation. The Holy Sect wanted to use Chen Nian as bait, the Heavenly Eye wanted to lock onto him through this, so he would turn their scheme to his advantage, showing them what true scheming meant."

choice.prompt: "The situation was now clear, Chen Ji had to determine his action plan—"

choices.description: "Create the illusion of heading to Holy Sect, actually have Ye Qing infiltrate and rescue using demonic path mist"
choices.visible_cost: "Expose Ye Qing's existence, owe a huge favor"
choices.risk_hint: "Uncertain whether Ye Qing can arrive in time"

text.content: "After hearing the plan, Ye Qing remained silent for a moment, then coldly laughed: "Feint? Chen Ji, you're betting your sister's life on whether I'll show up on time." She paused, "However... I enjoy this kind of thrill. Remember, you owe me a huge favor." With that, demonic path mist had already silently enveloped her."

choices.memory_label: 夜清答应配合声东击西

choices.description: "Personally step into the trap, but leave contingencies within the Tianji Record beforehand"
choices.visible_cost: "Extremely high risk, may fall into enemy's grasp"
choices.visible_reward: "See Chen Nian in person, seek opportunity to counter-kill"
choices.risk_hint: "Heavenly Eye personally set the trap, survival uncertain"

text.content: "Chen Ji sealed a wisp of divine consciousness into the Tianji Record Fragment, entrusting it to Mo Xiansheng's protection. He stared ahead, his voice terrifyingly calm: "Since they want me to come, I'll give them what they wish. However... who's prey, who's hunter, has never been my decision alone." With that, he stepped into the Void rift."

"The moment Chen Ji stepped into the Void rift, a familiar yet terrifying force enveloped him. After passing through endless darkness, his feet finally touched solid ground—This was the Holy Sect Forbidden Grounds, the air thick with decay and the scent of blood. In the distance, a massive altar stood at the center, and Chen Nian's figure was unmistakably there."

"However, Chen Ji did not charge forward immediately. His gaze swept across the surroundings, taking in every shadow, every formation rune pattern. A trap? Of course. But more than the trap, what caught his attention was the figure presiding over the ritual on the altar—Ling Yuan. The former Sect Master of Tianqing Sect, that always-merciful facade hiding the mastermind behind the scenes."

dialogue.content: "(Ling Yuan's laughter echoed through the forbidden land) Chen Ji... no, I should call you the Heir of the Tianji Record. This old man has waited eighty years for this day. You think you've come to rescue her, but you are the 'guest' I truly wished to 'invite.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji looked at that familiar face, killing intent churning in his heart, yet his expression grew ever more serene. He slowly spoke, his voice like ice: "Ling Yuan, you were abandoned by the Tianji Record back then, and now you wish to seize the inheritance through Chen Nian's blood? Laughable. Do you think these formations you've arranged can imprison me?""

"Before his words even finished, the formations on the altar blazed brilliantly, countless chains lunging toward Chen Ji. Yet Chen Ji merely raised his hand lightly, and those chains turned to dust in midair. His aura was fully released at this moment, the pressure surpassing Nascent Soul stage crushing down like substance, forcing even Ling Yuan to retreat several steps."

choice.prompt: "Ling Yuan's true face had been exposed, Chen Ji had to make the final decision—"

choices.description: "While Ling Yuan is unbalanced, rescue Chen Nian first, settle accounts later"
choices.visible_reward: "Younger sister safely leaves the dangerous area"

text.content: "Chen Ji's form erupted, shooting directly toward the altar. Ling Yuan coldly snorted, his fly whisk transforming into countless silver threads to intercept. Yet Chen Ji had already calculated the trajectory perfectly, breaking through like a破竹, instantly arriving at Chen Nian's side. He slashed through the chains in one stroke, pulling his sister into his embrace. Chen Nian weakly opened her eyes, tears streaming down her face: "Brother... I knew... you'd come...""

choices.description: "While the enemy's true face is exposed, accomplish everything in one decisive move"
choices.visible_cost: "Chen Nian continues suffering the ritual's torment"

text.content: "Chen Ji suddenly turned toward Ling Yuan, killing intent in his eyes as tangible substance. He spoke word by word: "Eighty years ago the Tianji Record abandoned you, today I'll make you彻底死心." Before his words finished, his fist had already arrived. Ling Yuan frantically defended, yet discovered he simply could not match the opponent's speed. With just one punch, the venerable Tribulation Transcendence old Sect Master spat blood and flew backward."

"However, just then, the sky suddenly darkened. A massive eye slowly opened across the heavens—that was the main projection of the Heavenly Eye's本体. It held no emotion, no expression, yet made everyone present feel the despair of being as insignificant as ants. Chen Ji raised his head to stare directly at that eye, his voice ice-cold: "You've finally shown yourself?""

"The Heavenly Eye gave no reply, merely descending a ray of grayish light, enveloping Ling Yuan within. The old ancestor's injuries healed visibly to the naked eye. He laughed wildly: "Chen Ji! You think you can oppose Heavenly Dao? The Tianji Record is merely a piece it set on the board, and you—are also! You will always be its piece!""

"Chen Ji ignored Ling Yuan's madness. He lowered his head to look at Chen Nian in his arms, at her pale complexion and the密密麻麻 of wounds covering her body, his chest feeling as if something was tightly gripping it. Rage? That had long since burned away completely. What remained was only cold resolve. He softly spoke into Chen Nian's ear: "Brother will take you home." Through the blood pulse resonance, Chen Nian heard these words, and tears burst forth once more."
